components.name: ICS-VEX Reverse SBOM Builder
components.description: Reverse-builds a CycloneDX SBOM-CVE per ICS device from the CISA ICS-CERT advisory corpus.

component.name: Siemens SIMATIC S7-1500 CPU 1518(F)-4 PN/DP MFP V3.1
component.description: ICS/OT asset 'SIMATIC S7-1500 CPU 1518(F)-4 PN/DP MFP V3.1' by Siemens, reverse-built from CISA ICS-CERT advisory data.

properties.name: ics:product
properties.value: SIMATIC S7-1500 CPU 1518(F)-4 PN/DP MFP V3.1

components.name: Expat
components.description: Streaming XML parser. Used to process device-description files and project configurations.

components.name: libxml2
components.description: XML processor used to parse configuration files such as IEC 61850 SCL and PLCopen XML.

components.name: zlib
components.description: Lossless compression library used to compress/decompress firmware images and logs.

components.name: libssh2
components.description: SSH/SFTP client library used to transfer configuration backups.

components.name: libcurl
components.description: HTTP/TLS client used for firmware-update downloads and cloud telemetry uploads.

components.name: OpenSSH
components.description: SSH server/client used for remote management and secure file transfer.

components.name: SQLite
components.description: Embedded database engine for alarm history, trend buffers, and local configuration storage.

components.name: GNU C Library
components.description: Standard C runtime and system-call wrappers used by applications.

components.name: OpenSSL
components.description: TLS/SSL and general-purpose cryptography library. Handles the device's secure communication channels and certificate processing.

components.name: Apache Tomcat
components.description: Servlet container serving the web-based supervisory client.
